cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Create minimal .env
env_content = """# Areloria Server Environment
# Generated by OpenHands fix script
NODE_ENV=production
PORT=3000
SUPABASE_URL=https://placeholder.supabase.co
SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET=placeholder_jwt_secret_for_development_only
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:password@localhost:5432/postgres
"""
sftp = client.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/opt/areloria/server/.env', 'w') as f:
    f.write(env_content)
print("Created .env")
sftp.close()
client.close()
EOF
